name: image-to-pdf
description: Convert images to PDF entirely in your browser. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, TIFF and more. No uploads, accounts or tracking.

paragraphs: A free, open-source image-to-PDF converter that runs entirely in your browser. Combine JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, TIFF and other supported formats into one PDF without uploading your images.
Version 0.1.0 · Project URL · Source · Report an issue
The project URL is the configured GitHub Pages destination. Publication and observed test results are recorded separately in verification.
features: Select or drop one image or a mixed batch; preview dimensions, format, size and orientation.
Arrange PDF pages with desktop dragging, move buttons, or Alt + ↑ / ↓ on a focused handle.
Rotate left/right, remove pages, add images and clear the session.
Choose Match image, A4, Letter, Legal, A3 or A5; automatic, portrait or landscape orientation.
Fit, fill/crop or retain 96-DPI original size; set 0/5/10/20 mm margins and white/black backgrounds.

whatItDoes.text: A free, open-source image-to-PDF converter that runs entirely in your browser. Combine JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, TIFF and other supported formats into one PDF without uploading your images.

requirements.text: Use light/dark themes, keyboard controls and a responsive workspace without an account or paid quota.
Use light/dark themes, keyboard controls and a responsive workspace without an account or paid quota.
No environment variables, credentials, backend or API keys are required for the application.
